0.1.0.name: close_dataset
0.1.0.description: Close a dataset and release its worker. New requests fail; already accepted requests may finish, with deadlines still enforced.

0.1.0.name: decode
0.1.0.description: Inspect a method or class. Exactly one method descriptor, method_idx (with file_id), or class descriptor is required. Classes default to paginated summaries; methods default to paginated smali. Follow next_offset for exact text continuation; context mode lists original line numbers for labels and catch directives. Query SQL tables for annotations and debug metadata.

DecodeMode.description:
Which `decode` view a request asks for. A class selection defaults to [`Self::Summary`] and a
method selection to [`Self::Smali`] (see [`run`]).

`JsonSchema` is derived here for the same reason as `apk::manifest::ManifestMode`: the MCP tool's
parameter schema is generated from this type (it is re-exported as
`cli::mcp::protocol::DecodeMode`), so the published schema and the implemented behaviour cannot
disagree.

oneOf.description: Method METADATA only: descriptor, access flags, code units, registers, try count.
The complete smali text of each selected method, paged by UTF-8 byte offset.

number — the view a caller uses to talk about a line it saw somewhere else.

max_lines.description: Maximum lines in one text page, default 200, maximum 1000.

method_limit.description: Methods per class page, default 20, maximum 50.

method_offset.description: Class method-list offset, ordered by method_idx.

mode.description: Defaults to summary for a class, smali for a method. Context lists original label/catch lines.

offset.description: UTF-8 byte offset into one method's smali/context text; continue with next_offset.

0.1.0.name: get_manifest_components
0.1.0.description: Page Manifest components, names/descriptors, launcher intent filters, aliases and exported configuration. Exported state is manifest-derived and is not a claim of runtime accessibility. Includes explicit and SDK-dependent default states.

kind.description: Optional activity, activity-alias, service, receiver, or provider filter.

only_exported.description: Filter by manifest-derived exported state; does not imply runtime accessibility.

0.1.0.description: List open datasets and server quotas/usage. Counts include opening datasets and accepted work still holding a closed dataset.

0.1.0.name: list_resource_files
0.1.0.description: Page archive entry names and sizes, optionally filtered by prefix (res/, assets/, lib/). Names identify entries for read_resource; files are never extracted.

prefix.description: Case-sensitive archive-entry prefix, for example res/layout/ or assets/.

0.1.0.name: list_tables
0.1.0.description: List all built-in SQL tables and views; no dataset is needed.

0.1.0.name: open_dataset
0.1.0.description: Open local DEX/APK/JAR/ZIP paths as an isolated reusable dataset. Resource-only archives are supported. Input/session quotas and operation deadlines apply. Close unused datasets to release memory.

inputs.description: Local DEX/APK/JAR/ZIP paths, resolved relative to the server working directory.

timeout_ms.description: Optional shorter operation deadline; cannot exceed the server's timeout.

0.1.0.name: query
0.1.0.description: Run a read-only SQL batch with exact typed cells, byte/row budgets and per-statement next_offset. Use stable ORDER BY when paging; SQL is re-executed against the current lazy session definitions on each page; CREATE definitions persist until DROP, replacement or dataset close. Running timeout/cancellation closes only this dataset. Use resources/list to discover the documentation.

limit.description: Returned rows per statement, default 200; use a deterministic ORDER BY when paging.

max_bytes.description: Optional lower serialized result-byte budget; rows are never silently clipped.

named_temp_queries.description: Lazy named SELECT definitions, retained in this dataset with the same lifetime as TEMP tables.

offset.description: Rows to skip in each statement's result, default 0. offset + limit is at most 100000.

sql.description:
Read-only SQL statements. VIEW and TEMP definitions are lazy and persist in this dataset
until DROP, redefinition, or close_dataset; results are not cached across calls.

0.1.0.name: query_resources
0.1.0.description: Query resources.arsc by numeric ID, exact type/name, type, name substring or configuration. Returns matching configurations with raw values and named references; complex resources are flattened into ordered map items. Separate from DEX strings.

configuration.description: Exact qualifier string from a previous result. Empty string selects the default config.

contains.description: Case-sensitive substring of the resource name.

name.description: Exact type/name or package:type/name, for example string/app_name.

resource_type.description: Resource type, for example string, layout, id, style, or array.

0.1.0.name: read_resource
0.1.0.description: Read one exact APK archive entry in bounded pages. Binary Android XML is decoded; UTF-8 text is preserved; other bytes use hex. Follow next_offset in page (text) or the result (hex). The resource-entry size quota applies before decompression.

ResourceFormat.description:
The `read_resource` output format: decide from the bytes, or force hex.

`JsonSchema` is derived here for the same reason as `manifest::ManifestMode`: the MCP tool's
parameter schema is generated from this type, which is re-exported as
`cli::mcp::protocol::ResourceFormat`.

name.description: Exact archive entry name. No files are extracted to the filesystem.

offset.description: Byte offset in decoded UTF-8 text, or original bytes when encoding is hex.

legacy_dexq.name: open_dataset
legacy_dexq.docstring:
Open one or more local .apk/.dex/.zip/.jar files (absolute paths) as one dataset.

The first open of a file builds an on-disk SQLite index (a ~30-dex host APK takes minutes;
small APKs seconds). Later opens of the same unchanged file are instant. Several inputs form one
dataset; file_id identifies each dex across them. rebuild=true forces a fresh index.

legacy_dexq.name: list_datasets
legacy_dexq.docstring: List datasets opened in this server session.

legacy_dexq.name: close_dataset
legacy_dexq.docstring: Forget a dataset id. The on-disk index is kept for the next open.

legacy_dexq.name: describe_tables
legacy_dexq.docstring: Schema of the index plus example queries. Call this before writing SQL.

legacy_dexq.name: query
legacy_dexq.signature: dataset_id: str, sql: str, limit: int=100, max_cell_chars: int=MAX_CELL
legacy_dexq.docstring:
Run ONE read-only SELECT/WITH statement against the index. Output is a tab-separated table.

limit caps the returned rows (max 1000). max_cell_chars is 1..16000 (default 300).
Truncation is reported; for longer values SELECT length(value), substr(value,1,8000),
then substr(value,8001,8000) with the same stable key and max_cell_chars=16000.
Preview lengths count escaped characters; SQLite retains the full value.
Output is bounded to 64000 chars at complete row boundaries. Times out after 60 s.

legacy_dexq.name: decode
legacy_dexq.signature: dataset_id: str, method: str, max_chars: int=12000
legacy_dexq.docstring:
Disassemble one method to smali-like text. method = 'Lcom/x/Y;->name(I)V'.

If the class exists in several dex files, all definitions are printed (each with its file_id).
Offsets are in 16-bit code units (hex), the same as smali/dexdump.

legacy_dexq.name: find_refs
legacy_dexq.signature: dataset_id: str, kind: str, target: str, limit: int=100
legacy_dexq.docstring:
Find where something is used. Scans instructions of the dex files that can contain a hit.

kind='method'  target='Lcom/x/Y;->name(I)V'  -> invoke-* call sites (callers)
kind='field'   target='Lcom/x/Y;->name:I'    -> iget/iput/sget/sput sites
kind='string'  target='exact string text'    -> const-string users
kind='type'    target='Lcom/x/Y;'            -> const-class/new-instance/check-cast/... sites
Output columns: file_id, class, method, proto, offset(hex code units), op.
Subclass overrides / interface dispatch are NOT resolved: an invoke names the static receiver type.

legacy_dexq.name: apk_info
legacy_dexq.docstring: Package name, version, SDK levels, permissions and component names of an APK (from its manifest).

remote_orchestration.name: plan_version_matrix
remote_orchestration.signature: samples: list[dict], request: dict, max_parallel: int=4, reuse_completed: bool=True, deadline_seconds: int=1800, runner_batch_size: int=1, execution_policy: str='fixed'
remote_orchestration.docstring: Plan 1..40 exact APKs over at most 4 runners. Default fixed preserves runner_batch_size=1..4 and old identities. execution_policy=adaptive uses balanced groups (native up to 12, otherwise 4); leave runner_batch_size=1. Its cold projection performs no network/profile reads; exact verified profiles bind at submission. Every sample requires inventory version_code/apk_sha256/sample_revision. No dispatch here.

remote_orchestration.name: submit_version_matrix
remote_orchestration.signature: samples: list[dict], request: dict, max_parallel: int=4, reuse_completed: bool=True, deadline_seconds: int=1800, idempotency_key: str='', runner_batch_size: int=1, execution_policy: str='fixed'
remote_orchestration.docstring: Create a durable exact-version queue. Fixed mode keeps runner_batch_size=1..4 and dispatches up to two jobs per call. Adaptive mode snapshots verified performance hints, balances bounded groups and fills up to four physical slots; leave runner_batch_size=1. Stable keys resume the original frozen topology even when profiles/main change. Unknown dispatches and failures never replay automatically.

remote_orchestration.name: advance_version_matrix
remote_orchestration.docstring: Refresh accepted jobs under the captured revision and at most 4 physical slots. Fixed queues dispatch at most two jobs per call; adaptive queues fill up to four. Call only while you intend progress. Capacity pressure keeps local entries; a deadline stops new dispatches without cancelling accepted jobs.

remote_orchestration.name: version_matrix_status
remote_orchestration.docstring: Refresh matrix job states without submitting additional work.

remote_orchestration.name: version_matrix_result
remote_orchestration.signature: matrix_id: str, offset: int=0, limit: int=8, download_parallel: int=4, prefetch_only: bool=False
remote_orchestration.docstring: Collect with 1..4 download workers and verified reuse. While later versions run, prefetch_only=true downloads only completed entries on this page, without candidate comparison or dispatch. For final comparisons use prefetch_only=false after the matrix finishes. collection_errors can be retried on the same matrix/page without new Actions. Large comparisons have immutable local snapshots. Static results do not prove working runtime hooks.

remote_orchestration.name: recover_version_matrix
remote_orchestration.signature: matrix_id: str, idempotency_key: str='', include_unverified_results: bool=False
remote_orchestration.docstring: Retry confirmed failed/skipped versions under the original tool commit and execution policy. Explicit include_unverified_results=true may repeat completed jobs whose member results remain unverified, including earlier successful work. Running/unknown dispatches stay excluded. The same key/opt-in resumes its queue; a new key authorizes another attempt. Uses Actions minutes; fixed/adaptive dispatch at most two/four initial jobs.

remote_orchestration.name: plan_analysis
remote_orchestration.docstring: Plan up to 16 related tasks without dispatching. Request: {backend:auto|sqlite|dexsql,tasks:[{id,operation,...}]}. query requires sql and dialect. DexSQL query.limit is page size; automatic continuation is bounded by pagination={max_pages:1..32,max_rows:1..10000,max_bytes:1024..1048576}, default 8/1000/1048576 and the shared batch deadline/byte budget. max_pages=1 preserves a single page. SQLite SQL is unchanged. locate requires kind/name; refs requires kind/target and methods|sites detail; decode requires a full method descriptor. This is a plan, not execution evidence.

remote_orchestration.name: submit_analysis
remote_orchestration.signature: version_code: int, request: dict, apk_sha256: str='', sample_revision: str='', idempotency_key: str=''
remote_orchestration.docstring: Schedule one bounded analysis batch. Related tasks share one APK fetch and one session per backend. DexSQL queries automatically continue under row/page/byte/deadline budgets. request.resume={run_id,attempt,request_id} explicitly imports a verified checkpoint from this repository; exact APK SHA and sample revision are required. Completed task payloads are retained and partial SQL continues at its admitted cursor, never by replaying its prefix. Resume defaults to a stable idempotency key; a new key explicitly authorizes another attempt. Ordinary arbitrary SQL is not completion-cached. Unknown dispatch is never replayed. Uses Actions minutes.

remote_orchestration.name: submit_job
remote_orchestration.signature: version_code: int, operation: str, argument: str='', max_cell_chars: int=300, source_mode: str='auto'

remote_orchestration.name: job_status
remote_orchestration.docstring: Get queue/running/completion state for a submitted request. Does not wait.

remote_orchestration.name: list_jobs
remote_orchestration.docstring: List the latest ten analysis runs.

remote_orchestration.name: job_result
remote_orchestration.signature: request_id: str, result_offset: int=0, sample_index: int=-1, page_chars: int=RESULT_PAGE_CHARS, result_file: str=''
remote_orchestration.docstring:
Download result artifacts and return bounded text plus local file paths. No APK or DEX.

Pages default to 32000 Unicode characters; page_chars accepts 1024..128000.
Combined previews are capped at three pages. result.txt (durable report: report.md)
is selected by default. Set result_file to job.json, summary.json, or another
returned text file's exact relative path to page metadata. file_pages lists cursors.
Pass result_page.next_offset back as result_offset, retaining result_file, until null. Reading pages
reuses the downloaded artifact; it does not submit another Actions analysis job.
Grouped jobs return a bounded group receipt and all file paths by default.
Set sample_index=0..11 to inspect/page a specific member, including failed members.
